tooling: wg-quick inside the guest; any client works because the guest is a full VM
chaining: A 14-day Japanese KVM guest is enough to measure whether a Tokyo address is what a target cares about, and to carry a WireGuard endpoint while it lasts.
binding_note: No constraint kind fits: the free capacity is a 14-day window, and 1 TiB/month is reachable inside it at the shaping a Tokyo KVM guest gets. The window, not a quota, is what ends the free use.

identity_cost.detail: [translated] 'If you select credit-card payment when you apply, you can try every plan free for two weeks.' The card is the condition of the trial, not a deposit: the manual states a three-month minimum contract for the paid service.

reliability_note: The paid service carries a three-month minimum contract per the vendor manual, so a trial that is not cancelled converts into a contract.
confidence_note: The two-week card trial is a vendor sentence with a date. The traffic allowance is not on the page read, so volume stays null.
